what_happened: Task 589's own archived completion summary (recovered via git show, since its specs/ dir is no longer in the live tree) already names the exact lint ('lint-test-root-resolution.sh', modeled on lint-test-harness-adoption.sh) and the sanctioned-vs-forbidden discriminator (git-first-guarded fallback = sanctioned; unconditional fixed-depth = forbidden), removing most of the open-question burden from this research pass.

Re-running task 589's own measurement method against the current tree found three additional, currently-live instances of the forbidden unconditional-walk-up shape that neither task 589 nor this dispatch's own citation named: test-state-write-spill-names.sh:74, test-source-store-path-lib.sh:136, and test-orchestrate-context-growth.sh:308,313-314. Two of the three silently mask a real-state-pollution/real-specs-leak guard into a false PASS when run from the deployed invocation path -- confirmed by direct cd-chain execution from both paths, not merely inferred. Recommend the plan fix these three as part of landing the lint so it can launch at zero violations.

Task file_scope in state.json declares the new lint at agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lint-test-root-resolution.sh, but every one of the 23 existing lints lives under scripts/lint/ and both verify-deploy.sh gate blocks and gate 25's input_corpus glob reference scripts/lint/*.sh. Plan sites it at scripts/lint/lint-test-root-resolution.sh and documents the divergence; file_scope is descriptive, not validated.

Dispatch asked to coordinate or serialize with task 584 over gate-registry.data. Live check: 584 is not_started and absent from this cycle's concurrent_siblings; a third claimant (604) is likewise not_started and undispatched. No live collision this cycle, so the plan records the standing re-read-before-edit rule instead of a serialization dependency.

suite_selection_select over the gate-registration phase's two paths (verify-deploy.sh, gate-registry.data) returned a 31-suite union out of 151 corpus suites, letting that phase declare interface rather than full with an honest, measured covering command -- a real cost narrowing established at planning time rather than guessed at.

Phase 1 migration of three invocation-path-dependent root-walk instances onto common_test_repo_root completed cleanly: all three suites produced identical pass tallies from both the source-store and deployed invocation paths, with no previously-masked defect unmasked.

Initial lint-test-root-resolution.sh draft, when run over the full cross-extension corpus (not just core), false-positived on two genuinely-safe suites outside core (literature/test-lit-pipeline.sh's ancestor-search fallback, sapience/test-sapience-capture.sh's inline-validated-candidate shape) that the plan's git-specific guard regex did not recognize. Generalized the guard to a structural 'enclosing if [[ -z ]] fallback' check and added same-line/nearby inline-literal validation recognition, rather than narrowing scan scope to core only or shipping with a known false positive.

lint-unit-integration-boundary.sh exits non-zero on the current working tree, but none of its 6 reported violations are caused by task 601: 5 are pre-existing, unrelated missing-classification-row suites (test-commit-source-store-path.sh, test-lint-roadmap-batch-proposals.sh, test-mcp-merge-target.sh, test-source-store-path-lib.sh, test-validate-no-python-state-write.sh -- confirmed via git log/status to be unmodified, long-committed gaps), and 1 is task 597's own concurrently in-flight, uncommitted edit to test-validate-artifact.sh (declared in its own territory file_scope this cycle). Task 601's own classification row addition (test-lint-test-root-resolution.sh, unit) is correctly present and does not itself trigger a violation. Not fixed here -- out of this task's scope.

Phase 4's two new scripts (lint-test-root-resolution.sh, test-lint-test-root-resolution.sh) were initially omitted from core's manifest.json provides.scripts list, causing real gate3 (manifest-match) and gate13 (orphan detection) failures surfaced by test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh. Confirmed resolved via a direct --only-gate 3,13 re-run. A second, unrelated pre-existing failure in the same suite (eager-load baseline / gate24 memory-setup.md finding, documented in known-failures.txt, foreign to this task) remains and is expected.
